design_philosophy: Optimistic, light, and tactile workspace for content creators. Uses generous spacing, hard black borders, and pastel accents to feel like a modern, trendy Gen Z tool, avoiding standard SaaS sterility.

surfaces.cards: bg-white border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] rounded-xl transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]
surfaces.upload_zone: bg-[#FDFBF7] border-2 border-dashed border-black rounded-2xl hover:bg-[#D1F2E3] transition-colors cursor-pointer p-12
surfaces.tags: px-3 py-1 border border-black rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Dashboard Control Room layout once media is uploaded: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8

structure.hero_empty: col-span-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh] text-center

components.button: bg-black text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-black/80 transition-all active:scale-95
components.button_outline: bg-white text-black border-2 border-black px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-all shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:translate-y-[2px] active:shadow-none
components.song_card: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between p-5 bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] gap-4
components.music_icon_button: w-10 h-10 rounded-full border border-black flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#FFDCC2] transition-colors
components.loader: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-black animate-pulse font-bold font-heading text-2xl tracking-tighter

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hard shadow expansion, slight upward translation (-translate-y-1)
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion staggered fade-in for lists
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use a bold kinetic text loader instead of a generic spinner. E.g., 'ANALYZING VIBES...'

images.description: Abstract pastel gradient art with soft waves, used sparingly as an overlay or background accent.
Golden sunset at a seaside café in Istanbul, used as a placeholder/example of media a user might upload.
Aesthetic cafe room, used as another placeholder for uploaded media.

accessibility.contrast: Black text on pastel backgrounds ensures WCAG AAA contrast.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements must have data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page workspace application using React and Tailwind CSS.
Avoid Shadcn defaults; customize UI components with the Neo-Brutalist styling (border-2, hard shadow) mentioned in 'surfaces'.
Implement the 'Upload Zone' prominently. Upon upload and analysis, split the view into Media Preview & Analysis on the left, and Song Recommendations on the right.
Do not use generic spinners. Use a bold text loader during AI analysis.
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons and actionable items.
For the 'Search on Spotify' button, use a simple <a> tag opening a search query on Spotify.
Store history in sessionStorage so the user can see recent uploads.
